name: photography
description: Photo shoots of people, events, products and places, delivered as edited photos.

deliveryDays.description: Days from the start of the deal to delivery.

howDealsGo: The buyer pays into escrow at booking and releases when the edited photos arrive; the shoot and the editing can be two escrows. A timer to the seller, set past the due date, pays finished work if the buyer goes quiet. Before paying, agree how many photos and who may use them.
